claims.claim_ar: وضع الظاهر موضع المضمر لزيادة تقبيح أمرهم (إظهار الصفة صراحة بدل الإشارة إليها بالمضمَر)
claims.claim_en: The explicit (overt) expression is placed where an implicit (elliptical/pronominal) reference might have sufficed — a stylistic shift that intensifies the reprehensibility of their act (making the attribute explicit instead of implicit).
claims.needs_review_reason: The source describes 'putting the explicit in place of the implicit' — this is mapped to 'iltifat' (a shift) but classical labels vary; mapping should be reviewed against target taxonomy.
claims.rhetorical_effect: increases moral reproach and vividness by making the offenders' action explicit

claims.claim_ar: تكرار لفظي لعبارة «الذين ظلموا» (إعادة ذكر الصفة/الفاعل لتأكيد الحالة السلبية)
claims.claim_en: Lexical repetition (takrar) of the phrase 'الذين ظلموا' — repeating the descriptor/agent to reinforce their wrongdoing.
claims.rhetorical_effect: emphasis on culpability; reinforces the identification of those at fault

claims.claim_ar: بيان أنّ تغيّر الصفة يستلزم تغيّر المنازلة/الذات — استخدام تغيير الصفة لتبيين تغاير المنزلة بينهم وبين السابقين
claims.claim_en: The commentary notes that a change of attribute implies a change of status/identity — the phrase uses alteration of attribute to mark their being different (and inferior) to the former group.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source speaks of 'change of attribute leading to change of identity'; mapping this observation to the specific maani subtype 'fasl_wasl' (separation/joining) is interpretive and may be contested; please review against classical definitions.
claims.rhetorical_effect: signals a categorical distancing: by changing the descriptive attribute the text marks them as a different (worse) group

warnings: Source chunks provided are primarily from Zamakhshari and a Darwish i'rab commentary; the requested author set (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir balagha) is not fully present. Extractions are limited to the supplied chunks.

Mapping of prose descriptions in the commentaries to the fixed device taxonomy (especially for 'وضع الظاهر موضع المضمر' and 'تغير الصفة منزلة تغير الذات') required interpretive choices; these mappings are flagged for review.
